The <b>{{lc:{{PAGENAME}}}}</b> is used to grind many materials into powders, a type of reagent used primarily in [[alchemy]]. A material cannot be processed at the mill until it has been researched at the [[study table]], after-which the material should list any decomposition reagents, potentially including powder.
